Brightening & Even Skin Tone: Niacinamide helps improve skin tone and reduce the appearance of dark spots and discoloration.

Antioxidant Care: Hippophae Rhamnoides Fruit Extract offers antioxidant benefits to protect skin from environmental stress.

How It Works
This serum features the Triple Vita Activer™ complex , combining Hippophae Rhamnoides Water , 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid , and Hippophae Rhamnoides Fruit Extract to enhance skin brightness and clarity. Niacinamide and Tranexamic Acid work together to visibly reduce dark spots, while Panthenol helps maintain moisture and comfort.

snapshot.pdp_description_raw:
Vita Niacinamide Dark Spot Serum Mask 
A skin-brightening sheet mask infused with a potent blend of niacinamide and vitamin-rich ingredients to target dark spots and enhance radiance. The lightweight sheet adheres seamlessly to deliver deep hydration and even out skin tone.

Scent: Unscented

Skin type: All skin types, including sensitive

Size: 1pc (20ml)

How It Works 

Brightening Boost: Formulated with Niacinamide (50,000 ppm) to visibly improve skin tone and reduce dark spots. 

Triple Vita Activer™ Complex: A powerhouse blend of Hippophae Rhamnoides Water, 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, and Hippophae Rhamnoides Fruit Extract that revitalizes dull skin. 

Targeted Care: Infused with Tranexamic Acid, Glutathione, and Bisabolol to soothe, protect, and enhance skin clarity. 

Gentle & Hydrating: A lightweight mask packed with Panthenol and Allantoin to calm irritation and keep skin moisturized.
